description: This file defines the Review model class within the OpenCart admin module for handling product reviews. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve reviews, as well as manage ratings and review statuses. The class interacts with the database, updates caches, and references product model functions.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Represents the review handling logic in the admin catalog module of OpenCart, managing CRUD operations and aggregations of product reviews.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Creates a new review in the database, updates product rating, and clears cache.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Updates an existing review record, recalculates the product rating, and clears cache.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Modifies the approval status of a review.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a review and updates the associated product rating.

methods.name: deleteReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Removes all reviews associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific review.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Calculates the average rating for a product based on approved reviews.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviews with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReviews
methods.description: Counts total reviews matching optional filters.
